title: Riverside Community Garden: Spring Planting Day
text:
Riverside Community Garden
Spring Planting Day
Saturday, 9 AM to 1 PM at the north beds.
Bring gloves and a water bottle. Seeds, tools and lunch are provided.
This season we are planting tomatoes, beans, squash and three kinds of basil.
Volunteers sign up at the shed on the day.
